findings.source_passage: My naughty eyes wandered down to his naked torso. That was very real. I blushed and averted my eyes from his body.
findings.source_locator: after Xander opens his wings and asks 'Are these not real enough for you?'
findings.why_it_matters: The self-descriptive 'My naughty eyes' is a voice-signature beat — the narrator catching and labeling her own treacherous gaze with arch self-awareness. The draft substitutes 'My glance, treacherous as ever' which is close in spirit but loses the specific comic register of 'naughty eyes' that defines Miriam's ironic self-commentary throughout the novel.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'My naughty eyes wandered down to his naked torso' verbatim, or preserve at minimum 'naughty eyes' as the narrator's self-labeling tag.

findings.source_passage: I whipped my head to him and frowned. 'Even if I wanted it, you think it's okay for me to have to jump through all these hoops to be your wife?' I leapt to my feet, taking the blanket with me, and spun around to face him.
findings.source_locator: Miriam's outburst after Xander promises to make her life the best he can
findings.why_it_matters: The physical staging — leaping to her feet, taking the blanket, spinning to face him — is a kinetically distinctive beat that dramatizes Miriam's indignant defiance and is characteristic of the novel's action-punctuated emotional confrontations. The draft has her 'whirling on him' without the leap and blanket-grab, losing the comic dignity of the gesture.
findings.suggested_fix: Restore 'I leapt to my feet, taking the blanket with me, and spun around to face him' to preserve the physical comedy and emotional staging.

findings.source_passage: A smile slid across his cute lips. 'I propose to teach you.'
findings.source_locator: Xander proposing the hunt, after Miriam says she's never hunted on horseback
findings.why_it_matters: 'Cute lips' is a recurring narrator-tag that marks Miriam's involuntary appreciation of Xander's appearance even mid-argument; its absence slightly thins the voice's characteristic self-betrayal pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'cute' or equivalent narrator-appreciative qualifier to preserve the voice beat.

findings.source_passage: He looked straight ahead and pursed his lips. 'I wish for your trust, not your fear or anger. I find it vexing at all that I had to choose a Maiden.'
findings.source_locator: after Xander releases Miriam and looks straight ahead
findings.why_it_matters: The source has Xander look 'straight ahead and purse his lips' twice in this chapter — first here, then again when revealing the trapped fate. This repeated physical gesture is a character-specific tell showing Xander's discomfort with the customs he upholds. The draft preserves one instance but merges the staging of the second occurrence, losing the deliberate repetition.
findings.suggested_fix: Preserve 'He sat up, and his arms and wings released me. The lord looked straight ahead and pursed his lips' as a distinct beat before the trust/vexing speech.

summary: The draft is substantially faithful but flattens two medium-weight voice beats — the signature 'naughty eyes' self-tag and Miriam's kinetic blanket-leap outburst — along with two minor character-voice details; no high-severity signature losses are present.
